reason: ₹21,999 is close to two months of everything our family earns, and with our weak grid I would also need the ₹6,500 solar kit, so it is really ₹28,500. Even ₹1,999 a month for a year is more than I can promise when hand-washing costs me nothing but my time.
objection: I don't know this brand from TV. If the battery dies in year four, will anyone still make the part? And will a cold wash really get the mud out of farm clothes, or will I end up scrubbing them by hand anyway?
would_change_my_mind: If a big brand I know from TV sold it, with the solar panel included, for under ₹12,000 or about ₹800 a month.
